title: pinus monophylla subsp. californiarum
intro: Pinus monophylla subsp. californiarum, commonly known as the single-leaf pinyon pine, is a subspecies of evergreen tree native to the southwestern United States. It is valued for its timber and edible seeds, which have been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits. The seeds of Pinus monophylla subsp. californiarum have been reported to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, providing therapeutic actions such as pain relief, wound healing, and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of Pinus monophylla subsp. californiarum seeds include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
